About Finance Tracker

A simple, private place to see everything you own — without handing your bank passwords to anyone.

Why we built it

Most families spread their savings across several places: a demat account or two, a US brokerage, mutual fund SIPs, a flat or a plot of land, money lent to relatives, fixed deposits and gold. Each lives in a different app or statement, so answering a simple question — “what are we actually worth?” — means an evening with a spreadsheet.

Finance Tracker started as that spreadsheet and grew into a full dashboard: every asset class in one view, returns calculated properly with XIRR, and a monthly expense log alongside so you can see what you spend against what you have saved.

Who it is for

  • Investors in India who also hold US stocks and want one combined net worth.
  • Mutual fund SIP investors who want true annualised returns, not just absolute gains.
  • Families tracking holdings across several demat accounts and family members.
  • Anyone working towards FIRE who wants to measure progress against real numbers.

How we treat your data

You type in or import only what you want to track. We do not connect to banks or brokers, we do not show ads, and we do not run analytics trackers. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes, and you can export or permanently delete your data whenever you like. The details are in our privacy policy.
